newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nordic Investment Bank to issue Taiwan-dlr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Nordic Investment Bank to issue Taiwan-dlr bonds.

text.p: Nordic Investment Bank plans to issue a T$4 billion (US$143 million) Taiwan dollar-denominated bond with a maturity of five years, Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday.
The central bank said in a statement that Nordic Investment Bank would become the fourth international bank to issue Taiwan-dollar bonds.
"This will help energise our country's capital market and push our country to become a regional funding centre," the central bank said.
Further details of the planned issue were not available, the central bank added.
Nordic Investment Bank finances investment projects and exports of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden.
The latest international bank to issue Taiwan-dollar bonds was the Central American Bank of Economic Integration, which made a T$6.8 billion issue on May 16.
The other two banks that have launched issues were the Asian Development Bank and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
